Dialogs.Dialog: Ah... what are you doing here？
Me？ I just came for a change of pace...
Geez. What's that supposed to mean？
Hehe. Well... I got to see you, so today was a good day.
No, never mind. Well, I'll get going. See you.
Hehe. A change of pace again？
Could it be... you thought you might run into me if you came here？
No, never mind. Well, see you... okay？
I wish we could go somewhere after this, but...
Yeah, I need to get home. Sorry, see you...
Ah... hehe, so this happens too.
You were watching a movie alone.
Are you watching one alone too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
No, it's not that. I just... wondered if I should've asked you.
Hehe, it's fine. Together next time, okay？
We ran into each other again. Alone？
Yes, I already finished watching and I'm heading home...
I see. Our timing's off, huh.
No. Next time, let's come together, okay？
Hehe, I can't tell if our timing's good or bad.
It's fine, don't worry. We can come together anytime.
...Hehe, found a cute boy in a place like this.
Hehe, I see... good. Working out is nice, but pay attention to me too, okay？
Hehe. Well, I have to go...
Never mind me. More importantly, are you thinking of getting all buff？
Rejected！ That's absolutely not allowed！ Never！
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Here again... are you dieting or something？
Health is a big trend, and working out is good, you know？ But...
Never ask a girl about dieting！ That's a warning!?
Could it be... you came to buy a present for someone other than me？
Geez... no need to panic like that...
It's fine, I trust you... sorry for saying something weird...
Ah, I have to go... see you？
Hehe, we ran into each other again...
I have to go, but... hehe, this kind of thing is refreshing, huh？
Ah... we run into each other a lot. Shopping？
Not really, I've got stuff going on too.
I see. I'd like to talk somewhere if we had time, but I have to go. See you？
Could it be... there's a poster of an idol you like in the entrance hall？
It's fine, it's fine. I'm an understanding girlfriend about that kind of thing.
Right. You're at that age, so it can't be helped if your eyes wander.
It's fine, it's fine, I get it. As long as I'm number one in your heart, I'll forgive you for looking at other girls.
Just so you know, it's not some weird event...
Hehe. I'll believe you for today. I don't want to be a nasty woman either. Well, I have to go...
Like I said, it's not that...
▲主人公＊▲. Hehe, you came here again.
Hehe, if you like it that much, invite me next time on a date？
Think about it？ Ah, I'm in the middle of an errand... see you？
Hey you！ What are you playing at an arcade for!?
A student's job is to study, you know？ Do you have time to play around!?
Just kidding, hehe. I was acting like a big sis.
I always wanted to say it once: "Stop playing and study！" Just kidding.
I'll let it slide today, so head home before it gets late, okay？ Got it？
Hehe. Boys really do like places like this, huh？
Hehe. I'm going now, but pay proper attention to your girlfriend too, okay？
Hey, young man, want to play with big sis？
Hehe. Did you take that seriously？
Too bad, though. Big sis is busy and can't play today. Bye！
Can I help you find something, sir？
Hehe. I always wanted to say that once. You can't at a family restaurant, right？
So, are you looking for something？
Just... how do I put it... browsing？
Hehe, don't bother the store too much, okay？
Yes, good. I still have errands, so I'll go ahead, okay？ Bye.
Did you find what you were looking for, sir？
Hehe, we meet again. Well？ My customer service outside the family restaurant.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you could work at any store.
Hehe, flattering me won't get you a discount, you know？
Come to think of it, I never did ask what you were looking for...
We run into each other here a lot. You like this store that much？
It's surprisingly good for wandering around aimlessly, this place.
Hehe, I see. Unfortunately I have a purpose, so I have to go... see you？
Ah, what a coincidence. Looking for something？
Well, obviously. It's a CD store.
Hehe, but you were cute just now, you know？
Hehe, shall I tell you my favorite CDs sometime？
And then... if you listen while thinking of me, I'd be happy.
What？ Are you a music boy, by any chance？
Guys with lots of hobbies are kind of wonderful, maybe？
Yes, yes, hehe, keep it up, okay？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What's up？ Why are you here？
Well, apparently they have merchandise from a movie I like, but I can't find it.
Will you show me for once？ Your reliable side.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what a coincidence. Movie stuff again？
Yes, something like that... will you come with me again？
Thanks. ...Hey, do you come here often？
You do come here a lot, huh...
You came along on my errand, but what's your business here？
Today's just a coincidence, a fluke...
Yeah, it is. But I have to go now.
This is a maid cafe, right？
Could it be you like places like this more than family restaurants？
Huh？ Not much of a reaction？
No. I saw you from far away and came after you.
